newsitem.title: USA: Leasing says Cisco business unaffected.
newsitem.headline: Leasing says Cisco business unaffected.

text.p: Leasing Solutions Inc said Tuesday that a leasing program signed between MLC Holdings Inc and Cisco Systems Inc will not affect the amount of business between Leasing Solutions and Cisco.

"We do not expect that MLC's announcement will have any material effect on the Cisco business we anticipated booking this year or next," Leasing Solutions President and Chief Executive Hal Krauter said.
The company did not state what precentage of its overall business is represented by its relationship with Cisco.

"(We) feel confident that we will meet or exceed our planned volume for Cisco equipment. We do not expect that this announcement will affect the amount of Cisco volume we expect to do this year or next," he said in a statement.
On Monday MLC Holdings said it signed an agreement with Cisco whereby MLC will be the preferred financing provider for Cisco's government, educational, and commercial segments.
